book.name: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan
book.title: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan Mulai neme Manetualain Ana tao lalai no daebafok

content: Esau numbu-sadu nala
Ia Esau numbu-sadu nala. Ndia nade feꞌen Edom boe.
Esau sao ina Kanaꞌan dua. Esa, hataholi Het, ndia Elon ana inanan, naꞌde Ada. Kaduan, hataholi Hewi, nade Oholibama. Ndia aman, nade Anah, ma ndia baꞌin, nade Sibeon.
Esau sao Ismael ana inanan esa boe, nade Basmat. Basmat anan, nade Nebayot.
Esau sao ulun, Ada, bonggi Elifas. Basmat bonggi Rehuel.
Boe ma, Oholibama bonggi Yeus, Yalam ma Kora. Bonggi basa Esau ana nala, leme Kanaꞌan.
Laꞌi esa, Esau huꞌa neni nusa feꞌek neu, fo dook neme Yakob mai. Ana no ndia sao-ana nala, hataholi manatao ue-ledis, banda la, ma basa ndia hata nala.
Esau kofeꞌe no Yakob, huu sila banda nala noꞌun seli, de ala lasoda lakaseꞌe lai nusak ndia.
Boe ma, Esau (ndia Edom), neu leo nai lete-letek manai Seir.
Ia, Esau numbu-sadu nala, fo lae, ‘hataholi Edom’. Ala leo lai dae babaꞌe lete-letek nai Seir.

Esau saon Ada, ana bonggi ana touanak esa nade Elifas. Elifas ana touanan lima, sila: Teman, Omar, Sefo, Gatam ma Kenas. Elifas sao nakaboin, nade Timna. Ana bonggi ana tou-anak esa, nade Amalek. Esau saon Basmat, bonggi ana tou-anak esa, nade Rehuel. Rehuel hambu ana touanak haa, sila: Nahat, Sera, Syama, ma Misa.
Esau saon Oholibama, na, ndia Anah anan, fo Sibeon umbun ndia, ana bonggi ana touanak telu, sila: Yeus, Yalam ma Kora.

Esau umbu-ana nala lababaꞌe dadik leo noꞌuk. Esa-esako no ndia mane leon. Esau ana ulun Elifas, ana nala mane leo Teman, mane leo Omar, mane leo Sefo, mane leo Kenas, mane leo Kora, mane leo Gatam, ma mane leo Amalek. Basa sala sila, Esau saon Ada numbu-sadu nala.
Esau anan Rehuel, ana nala dadik mane leo Nahat, mane leo Sera, mane leo Syama, ma mane leo Misa. Basa sala, Esau saon Basmat numbu-sadu nala.
Esau saon Oholibama ana nala, dadik mane leo Yeus, mane leo Yalam, ma mane leo Kora.
Basa leo la sila, Esau numbu-sadu nala.
Seir numbu-saꞌdu nala

Nai mamanak ndia, hambu hataholi Hori esa, nade Seir. Ndia ana nala lababaꞌek, de ala dadik leo noꞌuk. Esa-esak no ndia mane leon. Boe ma, ndia ana nala, dadi mane leo Lotan, mane leo Sobal, mane leo Sibeon, mane leo Anah, mane leo Dison, mane leo Eser, ma mane leo Disan.
Lotan ana nala, sila, Hori no Heman (Lotan feton, nade Timna).
Sobal ana nala, sila: Alwan, Manahat, Ebal, Sefo, ma Onam.
Sibeon ana nala, sila, Aya, ma Anah. Anah ndia, natonggo no oe mata matoꞌbik nai moo salaek, neu faik fo ana hoo ndia aman banda keledei nala.
Anah ana inanan, sila, Oholibama, ma ana touana nala, ndia, Dison. Dison ana nala, sila: Hemdan, Esban, Yitran, ma Keran.
Eser ana nala, sila, Bilhan, Saꞌawan, ma Akan.
Disan ana nala, Us ma Aran.
De, mane leo mane leo hataholi Hori la, sila: Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Anah, Dison, Eser ma Disan. Basa sala leo lai Seir.
Edom mane nala
Faik fo nusa Israꞌel manen bei taa, tehuu nai dae Edom hambu manek so. Sila nade nala latutungga aok, ndia:
Bela, fo Beor anan, ana dadik manek nai kota Dinhaba.
Bela maten, boe ma Yobab nggatin, dadi manek. Ndia aman, nade Sera neme nggolo Bosra mai.
Yobab maten, boe ma Husam nggatin dadik manek. Husam ndia, neme hataholi Teman asa nusan mai.
Husam maten, boe ma Hadad nggatin dadik manek. Aman, nade Bedad neme nggolo Awit mai. (Ndia ndia, senggi hataholi Midian neu faik ala latati leme Moab.)
Hadad maten, boe ma Samla nggatin dadik manek. Samla ndia, neme nggolo Masreka mai.
Samla maten, boe ma Saul nggatin daꞌdi manek. Saul ndia, neme nggolo Rehobot mai, nai lee bifin.
Saul maten, boe ma Baal Hanan nggatin dadik manek. Aman, nade Akbor.
Baal Hanan maten, boe ma Hadar nggatin dadik manek. Hadar ndia, neme nggolo Pau mai. Saon, nade Mehetabel. Mehetabel aman, nade Matret. Ma ndia baꞌin, nade Mesahab.

De, mane leo mane leo neme Esau mai, sila: Timna, Alwa, Yetet, Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, Kenas, Teman, Mibsar, Magdiel, ma Iram. Ala esa-esako foi sila nade hehelin, neu sila nusa nala. De, basa sila, Esau numbu-sadu nala, fo hataholi Edom asa tutuin.
